story.text: I have tried many ways to run a wiki farm locally (on MacOS). I now prefer running federated wiki directly in node.js with a LaunchAgent to use port 80 and to keep it running.
This page is a 🌿 Budding [[How To]].
story.title: Meta

story.text: (Re)install wiki to a known good state:

# stop the running wiki
launchctl unload \
  ${HOME}/Library/LaunchAgents/localhost.wiki.plist
# remove
npm remove -g wiki

# install
npm install -g wiki
# start the wiki
launchctl load \
  ${HOME}/Library/LaunchAgents/localhost.wiki.plist

I use a small deno program from the command line to compare with my current LaunchAgent configuration. This step protects me in case I make changes locally and forget to update this page with those changes.

# check for changes in the LaunchAgent
URL=http://deploy.wiki.do/assets/pages/launchagent-wiki/launchagent-plist.js
diff -u \
  <(deno run --reload --allow-env $URL) \
  $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/localhost.wiki.plist
I use the same program to install the LaunchAgent.
The program is hosted here in an asset folder and also displayed in a frame below for inspection and transparency.

item.text: We have many ways to run a wiki farm locally. This example runs wiki on our MacOS computer using node.js and federated wiki software. We configure a LaunchAgent to run our wiki on port 80 and to keep it running.
We host a small deno program in an asset folder which is also shown here for inspection and transparency. It generates a MacOS LaunchAgent configuration file.
pages/launchagent-wiki

http://deploy.wiki.do/assets/pages/launchagent-wiki/launchagent-plist.js
HEIGHT 800
I use that program from the command line to compare with my current configuration.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
URL=http://deploy.dbbs.co/assets/pages/launchagent-wiki/launchagent-plist.js
diff -u \
  <(deno run --reload --allow-env $URL) \
  $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/localhost.wiki.plist
This step protects me from my future self in case I make changes locally and forget to update this page with those changes.
I also use that program from the command line to install this launch agent to run wiki locally.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# install the LaunchAgent
URL=http://deploy.localhost/assets/pages/launchagent-wiki/launchagent-plist.js
deno run --reload --allow-env $URL \
  > $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/localhost.wiki.plist

# disable the previous configuration
launchctl unload \
  $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/localhost.wiki.plist

# enable the new configuration
launchctl load \
  $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/localhost.wiki.plist
